title: net1 on the concepts of BBRv3's width 7 seed 128
description: Step 4, first half: net1 learns the five recovered formulas of the seed search's hit, BBRv3's width 7 seed 128 with the window hidden (experiments/specs/concepts-s128.json, from release exp-controller-seed-search-49), as the estimator of the seven hand-picked LCFs was trained (experiments/specs/net1v4.json: a distribution over 64 bins, three members, width 512, dropout 0.05) and from the same 70 measurements. Data: exp-concepts-data-51, net1 v5's training set with the features the formulas read over past steps kept beside every 6th step; rows are every 12th step, split by link (seed 1, 15% validation, 15% test), BBRv3, Westwood and threshold-0.3 held out of training and reported apart (experiments/net1_train.py). Reported per concept: 90% coverage, R^2 and log loss on validation and test links and on the held-out controllers. Nothing is chosen here: the one net1 is the input of net2's training.
